department: Graduate Program in Earth & Space Science (Lassonde)

deadline.value: The program listing shows an international Fall deadline of March 15, 2026, which has passed and is not a Fall 2027 date; domestic Fall deadline is 2027-05-15.

gre_subject.value: No GRE requirement stated on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: The PhD requires a supervisor: a faculty member must agree to supervise you before you are admitted. Contacting supervisors early is encouraged but not required.
supervisor.quote: The MSc (Degree by Thesis) and PhD (Degree by Dissertation) programs require a student supervisor.

also.quote: If a faculty member agrees to supervise an applicant, that applicant will be admitted to the ESS program

funding.value: Domestic PhD students can expect about CAD 23,000 per year for up to four years, and international students get an additional tuition fee scholarship; support depends on available funds and satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: International students can expect additional assistance in the form of an International Student Tuition Fee Scholarship for up to four years

also.quote: This support is subject to funding available to supervisors and to our graduate program.

entry_route.value: A master's degree is the normal route; bachelor's holders must first register in the MSc and may transfer to the PhD after one year.
entry_route.quote: Graduates with a master’s degree in chemistry, physics, pure or applied mathematics, astronomy, engineering, or engineering physics from a recognized university, may be admitted as candidates (PhD I) in a program leading to the PhD degree.

also.quote: However, such graduates must first register as candidates for the MSc degree

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 88 (tests before January 2026) or 4.5 on the new scale (from January 2026), per the program listing.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL (Internet-based) 88 (for tests taken prior to January 2026) or 4.5 (January 2026 and after)
